input: Whenever I enter the wrong password, the login form spins and never returns an error. Refreshing fixes it until the next attempt.

output.probable_cause: The failed-login path may leave the loading state active.
output.suggested_action: Inspect failed-login handling and verify the loading state is reset.

input: On Firefox, signing in with a valid account always shows 'session expired' even though the password is correct.

output.probable_cause: Session validation may reject valid credentials in this browser.
output.suggested_action: Inspect authentication and session-validation logs for the failed sign-in.

input: I cannot reproduce the password reset email issue now; it worked yesterday on Windows 11.

output.probable_cause: The earlier email-delivery failure may have been transient.
output.suggested_action: Check password-reset delivery logs around the reported failure time.

input: Every attempt to sign out on Android 14 returns to the account page, so I remain signed in.

output.probable_cause: The sign-out flow may not clear the active session.
output.suggested_action: Inspect the sign-out response and confirm session credentials are cleared.

input: The navigation drawer overlaps the page title on an iPad when the screen is narrow.

output.probable_cause: The narrow-screen layout may not reserve space for the navigation drawer.
output.suggested_action: Inspect responsive layout rules at the reported tablet viewport.

input: Whenever I select dark mode in Safari, the settings panel stays white.

output.probable_cause: The settings panel may not apply the selected theme state.
output.suggested_action: Inspect theme propagation to the settings panel in Safari.

input: The submit button is too close to the form label on the checkout page.

output.probable_cause: The form spacing may be insufficient.
output.suggested_action: Review spacing between the checkout label and submit button.

input: On Chrome 129, the modal covers the close icon and I cannot dismiss it without refreshing.

output.probable_cause: The modal may be positioned above its close control.
output.suggested_action: Inspect modal stacking and close-control positioning in Chrome 129.

input: Whenever I request /api/orders with an invalid page number, the service returns a raw stack trace instead of a client error.

output.probable_cause: The endpoint may not validate pagination parameters before processing them.
output.suggested_action: Review pagination validation and error-response handling for the orders endpoint.

input: All users receive HTTP 503 from the inventory API, and the entire service is unavailable with no workaround.

output.probable_cause: The inventory service may be unavailable or failing its upstream dependency.
output.suggested_action: Check inventory service health and upstream dependency status immediately.

input: The API documentation says this field is optional, but sending a request without it always returns HTTP 400.

output.probable_cause: Request validation may incorrectly require the documented optional field.
output.suggested_action: Compare the endpoint schema with its request-validation rules.

input: Each time I save an order note, the database stores the same note twice.

output.probable_cause: The save operation may be executed more than once without duplicate protection.
output.suggested_action: Inspect write-call counts and idempotency handling for order notes.

input: The customer search query fails with a missing index error whenever the last-name filter is used.

output.probable_cause: The query may reference an index that is absent from the database.
output.suggested_action: Check the deployed indexes and the query plan for the last-name filter.

input: Customer addresses were permanently deleted for every account during yesterday's migration; no restore is available.

output.probable_cause: The migration may have removed address records without preserving them.
output.suggested_action: Stop further migrations and assess backups and data-recovery options.

input: The report page takes about 25 seconds to load when it contains a year's worth of results.

output.probable_cause: The report may process or retrieve too much data for a single request.
output.suggested_action: Profile query time and response size for a one-year report.

input: Every time we open the dashboard, CPU usage reaches 100% and the page becomes unresponsive.

output.probable_cause: Dashboard rendering or data processing may be consuming excessive CPU.
output.suggested_action: Profile the dashboard during load and identify the highest-CPU operation.

input: Search results are delayed by roughly one second, but the page remains usable.

output.probable_cause: Search processing may add a small response delay.
output.suggested_action: Measure search request latency across representative queries.

input: Whenever I save the form with a blank email address, the app crashes instead of explaining the required field.

output.probable_cause: The form may submit a blank email without client-side or server-side validation.
output.suggested_action: Check required-email validation and handling of empty submissions.

input: The phone-number field accepts letters even though it says digits only.

output.probable_cause: The phone-number validator may not enforce numeric input.
output.suggested_action: Review phone-number validation against the field's documented format.

input: QA could not reproduce the date validation error on any of their test runs.

output.probable_cause: The date validation failure may depend on an unreported input or environment.
output.suggested_action: Capture the exact date input and environment from the original failure.

input: Whenever the payment provider responds with a timeout, our order remains marked pending even though the provider charged the customer.

output.probable_cause: The timeout path may not reconcile the provider's completed charge with the order state.
output.suggested_action: Compare provider transaction records with order-state updates for timed-out requests.

input: The nightly export is missing newly created records because the downstream CRM sync stopped yesterday.

output.probable_cause: The CRM synchronization may have stopped processing recent records.
output.suggested_action: Check synchronization health and retry the missing-record export.

input: An unauthenticated user can read another customer's private invoice by changing the invoice ID in the URL.

output.probable_cause: Invoice access may not verify that the requester is authorized for the requested customer.
output.suggested_action: Restrict invoice reads by authenticated customer ownership and review access logs.

input: Someone exploited a remote code execution flaw in the image upload endpoint and is running commands on the server.

output.probable_cause: The upload endpoint may execute attacker-controlled input.
output.suggested_action: Isolate affected systems and investigate the exploited upload endpoint immediately.

input: After every deployment to staging, the worker fails to start because its configuration file is missing.

output.probable_cause: The staging deployment may omit the worker configuration file.
output.suggested_action: Compare staged deployment artifacts with the worker's required configuration.

input: The production release shows a blank page for every user and blocks the entire application.

output.probable_cause: The production release may contain a startup or asset-loading failure.
output.suggested_action: Roll back or disable the release while checking production startup and asset errors.

input: On Windows 11 with the latest runtime, the desktop app closes immediately after launch.

output.probable_cause: The application may be incompatible with the installed runtime on Windows 11.
output.suggested_action: Capture startup logs and verify the supported runtime version on Windows 11.

input: The page layout breaks on iPhone 15 when I rotate the screen to landscape.

output.probable_cause: The layout may not adapt to the device's landscape viewport.
output.suggested_action: Inspect responsive layout behavior on iPhone 15 in landscape orientation.

input: The export file is named report.csv, but opening it shows rows separated by commas as expected.

output.probable_cause: The report may be functioning as designed despite the naming concern.
output.suggested_action: Confirm the expected export format with the reporter before changing behavior.

input: Whenever I click the help link, nothing happens and the same problem occurs in two browsers.

output.probable_cause: The help link may not have a working destination or click handler.
output.suggested_action: Inspect the help link target and browser console for click errors.
